lemmas.name: fl_eq
lemmas.statement: ∀ (x : Int) (l : List Int), filterlist x l = l.filter (fun y => decide (y = x))
lemmas.proof:
by intro x l
  unfold filterlist
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [filterlist.aux]
  | cons y ys ih => simp only [filterlist.aux, List.filter_cons, ih]; split_ifs <;> simp_all

lemmas.name: fl_count
lemmas.statement: ∀ (l : List Int) (y : Int), (l.filter (fun z => decide (z = y))).length = l.count y
lemmas.proof:
by intro l y
  rw [List.count_eq_length_filter]
  rfl

lemmas.name: pair_le_countP
lemmas.statement: ∀ (l : List Int) (p : Int → Bool) (x r : Int), x ≠ r → p x = true → p r = true → (l.filter (fun y => decide (y = x))).length + (l.filter (fun y => decide (y = r))).length ≤ l.countP p
lemmas.proof:
by intro l p x r hxr hx hr
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a t ih =>
    by_cases hax : a = x
    · subst hax
      have : ¬ a = r := hxr
      simp [List.filter_cons, List.countP_cons, this, hx]; omega
    · by_cases har : a = r
      · subst har
        simp [List.filter_cons, List.countP_cons, hax, hr]; omega
      · simp [List.filter_cons, List.countP_cons, hax, har]; split_ifs <;> omega

lemmas.name: single1
lemmas.statement: ∀ (nums : List Int) (h : FindSingleNumber_precond nums), FindSingleNumber_postcond nums ((nums.find? (fun x => decide (nums.count x = 1))).getD 0) h
lemmas.proof:
by intro nums h
  unfold FindSingleNumber_postcond
  obtain ⟨hall, hcnt⟩ := h
  have h1mem : 1 ∈ nums.map (fun x => nums.count x) := List.count_pos_iff.mp (by omega)
  obtain ⟨x0, hx0, hc0⟩ := List.mem_map.mp h1mem
  have hany : nums.any (fun x => decide (nums.count x = 1)) = true := List.any_eq_true.mpr ⟨x0, hx0, by simpa using hc0⟩
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hrmem, hp⟩ := Refine.find_some_of_any nums _ hany
  have hcr : nums.count r = 1 := of_decide_eq_true hp
  have e : (nums.find? (fun x => decide (nums.count x = 1))).getD 0 = r := by rw [hr]; rfl
  rw [e]
  have hflen : ∀ y, (filterlist y nums).length = nums.count y := by
    intro y; rw [fl_eq]; exact fl_count nums y
  refine ⟨List.length_pos_of_mem hrmem, by rw [hflen, hcr], ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  by_cases hxr : x = r
  · exact Or.inl hxr
  · right
    rw [hflen]
    have hx12 := List.all_eq_true.mp hall _ (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩)
    simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at hx12
    rcases hx12 with h1 | h2
    · exfalso
      have := pair_le_countP nums (fun y => decide (nums.count y = 1)) x r hxr (by simpa using h1) (by simpa using hcr)
      have hc : (nums.map (fun x => nums.count x)).count 1 = nums.countP (fun y => decide (nums.count y = 1)) := by
        rw [List.count_eq_countP, List.countP_map]; rfl
      have hxl : (nums.filter (fun y => decide (y = x))).length = 1 := by rw [fl_count]; exact h1
      have hrl : (nums.filter (fun y => decide (y = r))).length = 1 := by rw [fl_count]; exact hcr
      omega
    · exact h2
